name: atlassian
description: Access Jira Cloud, Confluence Cloud, and Jira Service Management via a mySMB-owned OAuth app — projects, issues, JQL search, spaces, pages, CQL search, an agent-facing service desk queue with SLA tracking, and a priority-sorted open service requests queue. A customer-facing 'my open tickets' JSM tile remains a deliberate follow-up (needs a personal-connection rollout model).

connection.instructions: Click Connect and sign in to your Atlassian account. Your session is managed automatically — no manual token copying needed.
